en.headline: Fresh water supply disrupted in Kwai Chung after pipe leak
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is conducting emergency repairs on a 200mm pipe on Ta Chuen Ping Street that supplies Po Sing Centre, aiming to restore service by midnight.
body: The Water Supplies Department said a fresh water supply pipe on Ta Chuen Ping Street in Kwai Chung developed a leak on Sunday morning, interrupting supply to the private housing estate Po Sing Centre and nearby areas.

The 200-millimetre pipe serves the estate. The department received reports of the leak in the morning and has begun emergency repairs, with the target of completing the work by midnight. Eight temporary water tanks have been set up near the estate entrance and bottled water has been provided to affected residents and shops.

The Water Supplies Department apologised for the inconvenience and said it was maintaining close contact with the Kwai Tsing District Office, local district councillors and the estate management to support residents during the disruption.

zh.headline: 葵涌水管漏水 部分地區食水暫停供應
zh.dek: 水務署正緊急搶修打磚坪街一條200毫米食水喉，影響寶星中心供水，目標午夜前恢復。
body: 水務署表示，周日早上葵涌打磚坪街一條食水喉出現漏水，影響私人屋苑寶星中心及附近地區的食水供應。
該條200毫米喉管負責供應寶星中心。水務署早上接獲報告後立即展開緊急搶修，目標於午夜前完成。署方已在屋苑入口附近設置八個臨時水箱，並向受影響居民及商戶派發樽裝水。
水務署就事件造成不便致歉，並表示正與葵青民政事務處、區議員及屋苑管理處保持緊密聯絡，支援受影響居民。
